_comment: Seed for /usr/share/kyth/compat.json, the offline verdict DB consulted by kyth-exe-compat and the Hub exe dialog. Keys are either full SHA-256 prefix hashes (12 hex chars, strongest) or normalised installer stems as produced by exe_compat::normalise_filename (lowercase, wrapper and arch tokens stripped: 'Setup My.Game v1.2 x64.exe' -> 'my-game'). Keep keys lowercase. Statuses: Works / Likely / Unknown / Blocked.
